title: A ChatGPT Codex device code says ChatGPT accepts it only with Device code sign-in on, linking ChatGPT Settings › Security; other vendors' codes carry no such line
steps: S1: run the tracy-model-plan accounts-pane tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake /api/seat-plan doors): pick ChatGPT Codex, press Connect now with a device answer, read the panel; then the same with GitHub Copilot.
expect: The Codex device panel holds [data-hint='device-security'] reading 'ChatGPT accepts the code only when Device code sign-in is on in ChatGPT Settings › Security.'

Its link reads 'ChatGPT Settings › Security', href https://chatgpt.com/#settings/Security, target _blank, rel 'noopener noreferrer'; on the web a press follows the anchor itself into a new tab (no popup), in the desktop app it opens through openExternal (since #1227).
The GitHub Copilot device panel has no [data-hint='device-security'].

tests: a ChatGPT Codex code says ChatGPT takes it only with Device code sign-in on, linking ChatGPT's Security settings
a GitHub Copilot code carries no such hint

evidence: dev cowork.tracy.site 12/10/2026: OpenAI's consent page refused the first try with 'Enable device code sign-in for Codex, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word in ChatGPT Security Settings' (a per-account switch, off by default); the panel said nothing. Screens: tasks/evidence/device-poll-transient/codex-device-hint-{light,dark}.png
fence: the per-vendor note map in AccountsPane.tsx (DEVICE_NOTES) draws the note only for the vendor it names
